text:
sasha: Heads-up: nightly perf-harvest reported a ~12% p99 token latency regression on the main branch. CI attached an nsys snapshot + perfetto trace. nvtx boundaries around kvcache look unusual. perfetto: https://perfetto.dev/trace/zzYc1, artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/perf/1745003210/nsys.tgz

matt: I see it. Kernel selection appears to have flipped for a subset of batches — many small cuLaunchKernel spikes instead of a few big kernels. Run flags show --batch=adaptive --kvcache=on --kernel-policy=auto

riley: Sounds like batching heuristic oscillation. When sequence length distribution is bimodal the adaptive policy can thrash and spawn many tiny launches. nvprof shows repeated small cudnnGEMM calls with low occupancy.

ben: Quick heatmap I generated is at s3://redwood-ci/perf/1745003210/heatmap.png — there's a hotspot on kv_cache::evict around T+02:14. Evict + immediate recompute could cause extra kernels and cache churn.

perf-ci-bot: Job 98321: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/perf/1745003210/ (nsys.tgz, perfetto.json, logs.txt) :white_check_mark:

sasha: Repro commands for trace capture (put in the triage doc):
```
nsys profile -o out --trace=cuda,cudnn --capture-range=nvtx python run_infer.py --config cfg.yaml
# perfetto micro-trace
python perfetto_trace.py --duration 180 --out perfetto.json
```

matt: Proposal for CI changes: 1) Collect top-3 worst p99 nightly runs instead of only the median; 2) Add a 30s microtrace at startup to capture batching ramp; 3) Keep artifact retention 30d for perf traces. That should give us more signal on the kernel-selection transitions. :thinking_face:

riley: Also strongly suggest adding NVTX markers around kvcache::lookup / insert / evict and around kernel-policy decision points. If we correlate NVTX to kernel timeline we can see exact cause/effect. I can add those markers in the runtime PR.

ben: I'll build a small diff dashboard that overlays per-kernel total_time, call_count, and avg_input_size across runs and model versions. That will make regressions visible quickly. Also add a kernel heatmap per-run to the nightly artifact set.

sasha: Action items: @matt update CI to capture top-3 + microtrace + retention; @riley add NVTX markers in runtime; @ben add dashboard + heatmap ingest; I'll write a short regression triage doc after we get next night's traces. Goal: land all changes by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

matt: On it. I'll also pin kernel-policy to "stable-v1" for the next run to see if the regression goes away, then unpin after we confirm. Will update in this thread when done.

perf-ci-bot: Next run scheduled: nightly-perf-02:00 UTC, artifacts will be pushed to s3://redwood-ci/perf/1745080000/ when complete. :hourglass:
